user.title: DELTA 2 Max
user.description:
100% local BLE monitoring and control. No internet or EcoFlow cloud connection is needed during operation. No separate ef_ble is required. Cloud sign-in during setup is optional: you can enter a User ID manually.

UNOFFICIAL INTEGRATION. Not an EcoFlow product or an official EcoFlow BLE release. Use with caution and at your own risk; back up Home Assistant before installation. Provided without warranties; authors and contributors accept no liability to the maximum extent permitted by applicable law.

Choose a discovered station. If the list is empty, turn it on and enter its Bluetooth address.

login.title: Log in to EcoFlow
login.description:
Use the EcoFlow account bound to this station. Suris obtains the User ID and verifies it over BLE. Email and password are not saved. Close the EcoFlow app and disable other BLE integrations for this station.

CAUTION: this integration can change power outputs and charging settings. Verify every command at the station. Do not rely on it for critical loads or unattended testing.

user_id.title: I have a User ID
user_id.description:
Enter the numeric EcoFlow User ID. Setup completes only after successful BLE authentication. Close the EcoFlow app and disable other BLE connections.

CAUTION: this integration can change power outputs and charging settings. Verify every command at the station. Do not rely on it for critical loads or unattended testing.
